title: Resources
description: CPU, memory, disks and load of the homeserver and each k3s node; usage by app with drill-down to Pods.

list.name: workload
list.label: App

query.query: query_result(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$")))

list.definition: query_result(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$")))

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU cores of the homeserver, including everything on it (k3s VMs, Docker, services).

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: Share of CPU time used across all cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used = total - MemAvailable; available includes reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.

panels.title: CPU over time (cores)
panels.description: Cores in use; dashed: all cores.

panels.title: Memory over time
panels.description: Memory in use; dashed: all memory.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: System SSD (/), live data (black HDD) and backups (red HDD).

panels.title: Disk used over time
panels.description: Used bytes per filesystem; growth shows here first.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Time the disk was busy (I/O time). Near 100 % means the disk is the bottleneck (saturation, USE).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the last boot.

panels.title: Load (1 / 5 / 15 min)
panels.description: Run-queue length; compare with 8 cores.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU cores of the node VM.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory of the node VM.

panels.title: Root disk used
panels.description: The VM's disk (on the homeserver's SSD).

panels.title: CPU by app (top 12, cores)
panels.description: Container CPU per namespace and app (derived from the Pod name).

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(12, sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$"))))

panels.title: Memory by app (top 12)
panels.description: Working set per namespace and app.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(12, sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$"))))

panels.title: Apps (click an app to see its Pods)
panels.description: Shares are of the selected nodes together.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$"))

100 * sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$")) / scalar(sum(count by (node) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="k3s_node_exporter", node=~"$node", mode="idle"})))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$"))

100 * sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10})?-[a-z0-9]{5}$")) / scalar(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="k3s_node_exporter", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"(${workload:regex})-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|(${workload:regex})-[a-z0-9]{5}|(${workload:regex})"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="k3s_kubelet_cadvisor", container!="", pod!="", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"(${workload:regex})-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|(${workload:regex})-[a-z0-9]{5}|(${workload:regex})"})
